title: Missing Webhook Failure and Recovery Handling
description: Tests discovery of integration points lacking failure recovery mechanisms, retry policies, or dead-letter storage when remote services fail.

expectedRequirements.statementPattern: .*dispatches an HTTP POST webhook containing payment details.*

expectedFindings.rationale: The webhook dispatch operation defines no timeout, retry policy, backoff strategy, or dead-letter queue when the target endpoint is unavailable or returns an HTTP error code.
